workLog.title: Reproduced the backwards commit chains on current main
workLog.evidence: At 63a8e9b45 a probe over the episode corpus found commit-to-commit leads_to edges pointing from a newer committer date to an older one: 17 edges across 14 files. Eight of the nine files issue 3765 named are among them; the ninth (session-3423) carries 11 abbreviated SHAs that no longer resolve, so it has no verifiable edge. Six files the issue did not name carry the same shape.

workLog.title: Measured the relink-only repair the prior triage proposed, and rejected it
workLog.evidence: Calling _link_sequential_events on a deep copy of the 14 files takes 234 edges to 96 and strands 163 of 263 events with no edge, up from 4. An edgeless graph carries no backwards edge, so a backwards-edge check reads that as success. Rejected as deletion, not repair.

workLog.title: Added the commit-order check and the restamp-then-relink repair to the extractor
workLog.evidence: extract_session_episode.py: validate_commit_order flags a commit-to-commit edge that runs backwards in committer time; repair_commit_order restamps commit events from git via the cached _commit_datetime, rebuilds the chain with _link_sequential_events, and refuses any rebuild that loses edges. Wired into validate_episode_file so the existing corpus pin covers it. New --fix flag drives the repair.
